message: The other day, I found myself knee-deep in a kitchen disaster as I prepared for a storm that never even showed up. I had stocked up on snacks—because, you know, a good storm demands popcorn and a cozy blanket—but forgot to check if I had a flashlight. I ended up using my phone's flashlight feature to navigate my very own snack fortress. So, lesson learned: if you're going to prepare for a storm, maybe double-check your light situation! What’s your go-to storm snack? 🍿
